integrity: The finite verifier is integer-only and reproducible; it supplements, rather than replaces, the symbolic proof. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
limitations: Applies to three internally disjoint arms of lengths at least two, without weights. Does not classify all optimal geodesic families, vertex partitions, or graphs with more arms. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact two-or-three isometric-path covers of three-arm theta graphs
